feature_schema.column_order: list[str] — JSON-stable order of X columns (dict key order is not used after JSON roundtrip)
feature_schema.base_variables: optional; original_name -> kind/categories/reference/unit for C09 widgets

exported_interface.encoder_state: declarative JSON-safe mapping (seen levels, reference, impute stats, column_order, locale, missing_policy). Not executable code. Persist with json.dumps of feature_schema+encoder_state; DataFrames stay in-process.
exported_interface.subject_raw: mapping of original names to values, e.g. {"bairro": "Centro", "area": "1.234,56"}. Never dummy names.
exported_interface.sample_ledger: received, observed_target, prepared, used, excluded, used_row_ids, excluded_row_ids, exclusions[{row_id, reasons}], n_effective

required_callsite.C10: backend/worker.py process_file currently expands dummy names after DataLoader.load_data one-hot. Replace that path with ingest_market (C01) + fit_dataset/transform_subject (C02). Do not edit worker.py in C02.
required_callsite.C09: frontend/components/forms.py avaliando editor is numeric-only. Draw widgets from feature_schema.base_variables (categorical dropdown of seen levels + numeric with unit). Collect original values. Do not edit forms.py in C02.
required_callsite.C04: fit_candidate(prepared_dataset, ...) consumes PreparedDataset.X/y/row_ids/base_frame/feature_schema/encoder_state and parameter_accounting for free parameters / groups. Keep indicator groups atomic; do not split group columns.
required_callsite.C05: search_models(prepared_dataset, subject_design, ...) uses the same schema; do not propose transformations of indicators by default.
required_callsite.C07: evaluate_procedure fit_select_predictor(train_row_ids, seed) must call fit_dataset(..., train_row_ids=train_row_ids) so reserved rows never leak into categories/means.
required_callsite.C14: evaluate_batch transforms each subject with the frozen feature_schema/encoder_state from FrozenProject.

notes: candidate_cols=[] is an explicit error (no variables authorized). candidate_cols=null selects by role=predictor.
missing_policy must be declared before fit: target=never_impute; predictors=complete_case|mean|median (train-only).
Unknown category policy is unsupported: SubjectDesign.supported=false, group columns NaN, never all-zeros (reference).
Absence is not the reference category.
High cardinality is encoded with a diagnostic; it is not a technical impossibility.
InputBundle fixtures in tests/c02_schema are synthetic MP/1, not C01 ingest_market.
